meta.description: KUL Enterprises is a licensed and insured freight carrier, USDOT {usdot}, MC {mc}. Verify our authority and insurance filing directly with the FMCSA.

commitments.heading: What we hold ourselves to
commitments.note: Standing policy, applying from the first load.

items.title: Maintenance
items.body: Safety concerns are addressed before schedule pressure. Equipment is inspected and maintained with one objective in mind: if something may affect safe operation, we evaluate it before asking the driver to continue. A change the driver notices in steering, braking, vibration, sound, or handling is reason enough to check it, with or without a warning light.

items.title: Hours of service
items.body: Hours are planned before dispatch. If a lane cannot be completed legally or safely, we say so before accepting it, not after we are already late.

items.title: Communication
items.body: When a meaningful delay or safety concern develops, we communicate early. You hear the problem from us while there is still time to respond, not after the outcome is unavoidable.

items.title: Cargo
items.body: Every load is handled as a responsibility entrusted to us. Proper securement, documentation, equipment condition, and careful handling protect more than freight; they protect our customer's business and reputation.

manifesto.body: When a legitimate safety concern arises, the unsafe operation stops. Then our team goes to work finding another way forward.
manifesto.close: Safety does not mean we stop moving. It means we find a safer way to move forward.
